decisions.reason: As a low-cost complementary service tied to the installed base and the firm's application and support capabilities, it still preserves option value with little downside to keeping it available.

Because this accessory builds directly on the firm's existing machines, modular engineering, and service network, it is relatively inexpensive to maintain and still useful as a complementary option for customers.

As a more distant and uncertain offering outside the firm's core machinery focus, the learning period since launch is likely sufficient by now to justify reallocating resources if traction has not clearly materialized.

A high-speed CNC milling machine line is close to the firm's core business, fits its R&D and sales strengths, and merits continued commitment because its strategic value is high and uncertainty can still resolve favorably across models.
This automatic tool change system complements the firm's equipment portfolio and customer productivity promise, so keeping it on the market remains a sensible low-to-moderate-cost option.
